name: v0.3.46 — Steals back to native + scrollable in-app screens
releaseNotes:
• Steals is fast and native again — search, scrolling and results all work smoothly.
• Fixed scrolling and tapping on the in-app web screens (Reports, Stores, Rewards, Guacanomics, GuacWizard) — they now respond properly to touch.
• Dashboard icon menu + raised active tab from v0.3.45 included.
